slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Kenya launched an AI and Emerging Technologies Technical Committee to develop its first National Policy on AI and Emerging Technologies, with substantial drafts expected by March 2026 and finalisation by June 2026; the update covers January and February 2026 and gives no day.
facts.system: National Policy on AI and Emerging Technologies
